cd /workspace && timeout 280 python3 - <<'EOF'
import time
from verification.cex_minimizer import CEGARLoop
from verification.experiments.cegar_exp import (
    build_off_by_one_counter, build_double_counter, build_array_bounds,
    build_nonnegative_loop, build_producer_consumer,
)

specs = [
    ("sys1_offbyone", build_off_by_one_counter, {}),
    ("sys2_double", build_double_counter, {"max_iterations": 60, "predicate_budget": 100}),
    ("sys3_array", build_array_bounds, {}),
    ("sys4_loop", build_nonnegative_loop, {}),
    ("sys5_prodcons", build_producer_consumer, {}),
]
for name, builder, kw in specs:
    s = builder()
    if name == "sys4_loop":
        kw = dict(kw, initial_predicates=[s.state_vars[0] >= 0])
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    loop = CEGARLoop(s.init, s.trans, s.safety, **kw)
    res = loop.run()
    dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
    print(f"{name}: safe={res.safe} iters={res.iterations} added={loop.predicates_added} "
          f"cex_len={res.cex.length if res.cex else None} time={dt:.2f}s")
    print("   preds:", [str(p) for p in res.predicates])
EOF
